create_end_user: create a new end user with an optional model region and budget id via the /end_user/new endpoint
generate_api_key: generate an API key with optional budget, model access, user id, and team id via /key/generate
create_budget: create a new budget with a tpm limit via the /budget/new endpoint
test_end_user_parallel_creation: test parallel creation of ten end users by calling /end_user/new concurrently with asyncio gather
test_end_user_tpm_rate_limit: test that end user tpm limits enforce rate limiting on chat completion requests with both master and generated keys
